subject: Pilot: export assurance, subprocessor inventory, and no-train evidence
messages:
From: Michael Ortega <michael.ortega@clearsight.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot: export assurance & no-training evidence

Sofia —

Thanks for the demo earlier this week. As we scope the pilot for ClearSight (50k monthly queries, PII redaction layer on our side), procurement and our privacy team have a couple of gating asks before we can sign:

1) A contractual "no-training / do-not-use-for-model-improvement" commitment for pilot data (we need both a DPA appendix and an operational assurance).
2) A current subprocessor inventory (who will see or process the data downstream) and cadence for updates.
3) Proof of KMS residency for customer-managed keys (our legal requires EU residency for EU data).
4) SOC2 or similar evidence for the stack that will see our tenant.

Can you provide an evidence pack and a recommended short attestation (one page) we can include in the PO? Procurement is aiming to close this by end of next week (7/13).

Also: we may need a signed attestation that Redwood will only store transient KV cache for the pilot and that prompt/response copies won't be used outside of the pilot routing.

Appreciate a quick read on feasibility and timeline.

Best,
Michael Ortega
Director of Product & Data Privacy
ClearSight Analytics
attachments: none
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Ortega <michael.ortega@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Jul 2028 12:35:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot: export assurance & no-training evidence

Michael —

Thanks for the clear list. I can get you a compact evidence pack this week. Looping in Kimberly (legal) and David (privacy/ops) to confirm the contractual language and the operational attestation.

Proposed immediate steps:
- Kimberly: provide DPA appendix draft + one-page attestation template.
- David: provide subprocessor inventory, SOC2 stub, and KMS residency diagram; confirm ephemeral KV behavior for the pilot.
- I will attach the pack to a short email back to you and include a DocuSign template if you want a signature on the attestation.

Can you confirm whether EU-resident keys must be in a customer-managed KMS (HSM) or whether Redwood-managed EU KMS with contractual residency is acceptable? That will affect timing.

Deliverable target: initial pack by Fri 2028-07-06 EOD, final signed attestation by 2028-07-12 if doc sign-off goes smoothly.

Regards,
Sofia
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: none
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Michael Ortega <michael.ortega@clearsight.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Jul 2028 08:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot: export assurance & no-training evidence

Michael —

Appreciate the level of detail. Below is what we can provide and the options available for the pilot. I included an internal note on operational evidence steps for your team to validate.

What we will provide (initial pack, attached stubs):
- SOC2 Type 2 summary (redacted): SOC2-Type2-stub.pdf
- Current subprocessor inventory (CSV): subprocessor-inventory-2028.csv (includes region, subprocess role, contractual scope)
- KMS residency diagram (illustrates EU key zones): kms-residency-diagram.png
- One-page attestation template (fillable): attestation-template.docx

Contractual options for no-training / derivative use:
1) Standard DPA Appendix: explicit clause that Redwood will not use pilot customer data for model training or model improvement; data is processed solely for live inference and telemetry necessary for SLOs. We can add exportability and retention limits.
2) Operational commitment: we will enable an operational flag on your tenant that disables logging of prompts and blocklisting of any data flows to training pipelines. For the pilot we implement this as: ephemeral KV only, 24-hour retention for any debug traces (default 0-24 based on your preference), and audit logs accessible to you on request.
3) Incidents & verification: periodic attestation (signed) plus an audit extract (timelines, redaction sampling) we deliver upon reasonable request. For high-assurance customers we can scope a third-party attestation (separate engagement).

Notes on subprocessor cadence and cross-border transfers:
- Inventory is current as of 2028-07-01; we update the master inventory quarterly and will notify customers 30 days before onboarding any new subprocessor with material access.
- For EU data: we support both customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key) located in EU cloud regions, and Redwood-managed KMS where keys are provisioned in EU-only zones under our contractual commitments. If you require HSM-backed customer-managed keys (HSM in EU), we can support that but it typically adds 2–3 weeks to onboarding.

Operational evidence we can provide as a follow-up (timeline in parentheses):
- Tenant audit extract showing KV retention & purge logs (3 business days).
- Sample redaction/metadata export showing PII scrubbing in the pipeline (3–5 business days).
- Attestation signed by Redwood Legal (DocuSign template provided) (2 business days after final language).

Attached are the stub artifacts. If those look good I will draft the DPA appendix language and the one-page attestation for signing.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Privacy & Legal, Redwood Inference
attachments: SOC2-Type2-stub.pdf; subprocessor-inventory-2028.csv; kms-residency-diagram.png; attestation-template.docx
From: Michael Ortega <michael.ortega@clearsight.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearsight.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Jul 2028 08:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot: export assurance & no-training evidence

Thanks, Kimberly & team — this is very helpful. A couple quick clarifications before we circulate to procurement:

- Subprocessor cadence: quarterly updates + 30-day notice is acceptable. Can you add an explicit commitment that any subprocessor with access to plaintext prompt/response material must be EU-resident for EU-designated tenants (unless a specific exception is requested and approved)?

- KV and debug retention: for pilot we want the default to be 0 retention for prompt/response copies and 24 hours for ephemeral debug traces. Can you confirm you can set that per-tenant?

- Attestation: procurement will want the one-page attestation signed and returned. Please push the DocuSign link and we can sign on our side.

- Cross-border: for the pilot we prefer Redwood-managed EU KMS with contractual residency (rather than BYOK) to speed onboarding. Understanding the 2–3 week delta for HSM — not required for pilot.

If you can confirm the two bullets above and send the DocuSign attestation by EOD today we can include this in the PO flow.

-Michael

On attachments: procurement also asked for a simple mapping of what artifacts prove the no-train commitment (one-liner per artifact). If you can add that to the attestation page that would be ideal.
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Ortega <michael.ortega@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Jul 2028 09:34:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot: export assurance & no-training evidence

Michael —

Agree on all counts. Quick confirms:
- We will include the subprocessor residency commitment in the DPA appendix (EU-designated tenants: subprocessors with plaintext access will be EU-resident unless an exception is requested).
- We can set per-tenant retention: prompt/response copies = 0 (no persistent storage), debug traces = configurable up to 24h (we will set 24h by default for the pilot, can reduce to 0 if you prefer).
- Sending DocuSign attestation link now (and will add the artifact one-liners on the attestation page).

Next actions from Redwood (I will follow up with links and the DocuSign envelope):
1) Final DPA appendix draft sent to your legal (Kimberly will share).
2) Attestation DocuSign (Sofia to send) — expect DocuSign by 2028-07-06 11:00 EDT.
3) Tenant config checklist for pilot (David) — includes KMS residency steps and retention flags.

If that timeline works I will mark this as "ready for procurement" and you can route the PO.

Best,
Sofia
attachments: DocuSign envelope reference (sent)
